# Scouting Forms from the National Council

 _To obtain an up-to-date and official copy of any other Scouting form not
listed below, contact your local[council service center](/about/local-council-
locator/). _

## Membership Applications

  * Youth Application:
    * [English ](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/pdf/524-406.pdf) and [Spanish](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/pdf/524-423.pdf)
  * Adult Application:
    * [English](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/pdf/524-501.pdf)
  * [Merit Badge Counselor Information](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/pdf/34405.pdf)

## Registration Resources

  * The 2024 Registration Guidebook can be found in two locations:
    * My.Scouting.org>Menu>Registrar Tools>User Guide>Registration Guidebook
    * MyBSA>Resources>BSA Resources>Registration Resources>Manuals, Resources, & Reference Guides.

  * [ National Eagle Scout Association Scholarship Applications](https://nesa.org/for-eagle-scouts/scholarships/)
  * [National Eagle Scout Association Membership Application](https://directory.scouting.org/purchase-membership)
  * [Spirit of the Eagle Application](https://filestorage.wpengine.com/filestore/pdf/Spirit%20of%20the%20Eagle%20Award.pdf)
  * [Application for Alternative Eagle Scout Rank Merit Badges](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/pdf/512-730.pdf)
